slides.lead: No team, no manager, no standup. Here's what keeps a solo build moving.
One to-do list. Top item = the thing a real user would notice first. Not the fun refactor.
"Done when it's perfect" never ends. "Done by Friday" ships.
Learning a new stack and launching a product at the same time is two projects.

slides.h2: If you do it twice, script it.
slides.lead: Builds, screenshots, release notes. Every minute saved goes back into the product.
Smaller changes = smaller reviews, fewer bugs, faster feedback.
Block time for marketing and talking to users. Nobody else is going to do it.
